description: Summarize the user's agent treasury activity over a window (24h / 7d / 30d / all): total USD spent, tx count, spend broken down by chain and by source (send / recurring / redstone-trigger / yield / request / batch), the top vendors paid, active scheduled payouts and the next fire time, open vs paid payment requests, open vs disputed escrow, and the observable failures/holds (recurring rules that hit their cap or errored, disputed escrows). Use for 'summarize my treasury', 'why did my balance drop yesterday' (window:24h), or 'what did we spend this week'. Read-only and free: any live API key (Trial or Multichain).
name: q402_memory_summary
